call_points.text: Order intake up 36% QoQ but down 11% YoY, indicating mixed demand environment.
Cash balance strong at ₹688.9 Cr, providing flexibility for investments.
New CEO Anish Sarkar and Chief Growth Officer Bimaljeet Singh Bhasin appointed in Q3.
Management stated that the company is past the peak of its platform and product investment cycle.

timeline.summary: NIIT Limited reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹99.74 Cr with order intake at ₹86.9 Cr.
NIIT reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹99.7 Cr, up 16% YoY, with a full-year revenue of ₹3,902 million growing 9%.
NIIT Limited launched six new GenAI programs on May 21, 2026, to expand its AI learning portfolio.
NCLT Chandigarh sanctioned the scheme of amalgamation of IFBI and RPS Consulting into NIIT Limited.
October 14, 2026: NIIT Limited announced resignation of CEO Pankaj Jathar and appointment of Anish Sarkar as CEO, effective immediately.
The Income Tax Department filed an appeal before the ITAT against NIIT Limited for AY 2018-19 involving a tax effect of ₹1.72 Cr.
NIIT reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹98.2 Cr, down 6% YoY but up 3% QoQ, with EBITDA turning positive at ₹2.7 Cr.
NIIT recommended the appointment of Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP as statutory auditor for a five-year term starting from the 44th AGM.
NIIT Limited posted link to audio recording of investors/analysts call held on 27 October 2026 after announcing unaudited financial results for quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026.
